question.text: Amongst the following statements, that which was not proposed by Dalton was :

options.text: chemical reactions involve reorganization of atoms. These are neither created nor destroyed in a chemical reaction.
all the atoms of a given element have identical properties including identical mass. Atoms of different elements differ in mass.
when gases combine or reproduced in a chemical reaction they do so in a simple ratio by volume provided all gases are at the same T & P.

solution.text: When gases combine or reproduced in a chemical reaction they do so in a simple ratio by volume provided all gases are at the same T & P.
